text:
Ugh - how annoying. Are you entering through this link? https://www.gov.il/he/service/requesting-status-for-foreign-life-partner Your existing application should be listed there and so if it isn't, that is strange. 

You can try can try calling the technical call center of the national digital service at 1299 - if it is a bug, they should be able to solve it. If they can't, you may need to email your branch (are you even in the Bnei Brak office, or is this random?) and tell them you are trying to submit a renewal application online but it says you can't. If they don't answer you will need to go in person, unfortunately.
